results.what: Lecture announcement for Wintersemester 1858/59: PDEs with physical applications; theoretical physics (elasticity, mechanical heat theory); functions of a complex variable, especially hypergeometric series (here only as show-through of the recto)
results.usually_credited_to: Bernhard Riemann (his Göttingen teaching is documented, e.g. in the lecture lists and in Hattendorff's and later editions of his PDE lectures)

deep.surprise_reason: The page carries only bleed-through of an administrative lecture announcement already legible on the previous folio. It has no mathematical content, and Riemann's 1858/59 courses (including hypergeometric functions, cf. his 1857 paper) are well documented.
transcription_corrections: The page is not independent illegible text. It is show-through/offset of folio 41r and should be read as: 'Wintersemester 18 58/59 / 1, Integration der partiellen Differentialgleichungen mit Anwendungen auf physikalische Fragen. Mon. Dienst. Donn. u. Freit. 12-1 Uhr. / 2, Theoretische Physik, insbesondere Theorie der Elasticität und mechanische Wärmetheorie an denselben Wochentagen 9-10 Uhr. Anfang d. 1. Nov. / 3, Functionen einer veränderlichen complexen Größe, insbesondere über hypergeometrische Reihen und verwandte Transcendenten, an denselben Tagen 4-5 Uhr. Anfang d. ... October. / B. Riemann'.
In the image the faint text appears in normal reading orientation rather than clearly mirror-reversed. It may be an offset or transmitted-light view, but either way its content duplicates the recto.
